title: Mephistroth
wikitext: {{Npcbox | name = Mephistroth | image = Mephistroth.png | level = ?? | type = Boss | faction = Boss | aggro = {{Aggro|-1|-1}} | race = Nathrezim | creature = Demon | location = [[Hand of Mephistroth]], [[Tower of Karazhan]] | status = Killable | instance = Tower of Karazhan }} '''Mephistroth''' is the ruler of the Rock of Desolation and one of the most powerful of the [[nathrezim]], second only to [[Tichondrius]].{{questlong|Neutral|60R|Sovereign of Desolation}} Mephistroth remained in the [[Twisting Nether]] during the [[Third War]],[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Dreadlords_Convene_(WC3_Undead) The Dreadlords Convene (WC3 Undead)] but in the aftermath of the Legion's defeat at [[Mount Hyjal]] began scheming to use the abandoned tower of [[Karazhan]] and its leyline to open a link to Azeroth and begin a new invasion. He serves as the ninth and final boss of [[Tower of Karazhan]]. ==Objective of== * Drops [[Soul of the Dreadlord]] for {{questlong|Neutral|60R|Scythe of the Goddess (9)|Scythe of the Goddess}}. ==Quotes== ;Aggro :I foresaw your arrival, did you not think I watched your adventures within the tower of Karazhan? The link between our worlds shall slowly open, and with it the Burning Legion shall consume all! ;Hellfire Shards :My plan has long been in the making, your pathetic power has no place here! ;Death :This can not be! My purpose is brought to ruin... Our power is unmatched, do not savor your victory, for we shall come...
